content.rendered:
The end of the school year is quickly drawing to a close! We have had a wonderful year at Archer Glen with many memorable moments. 

The following is the schedule for our last week and a half:
Wed., June 6th –     Zumberis’ class to Tualatin Wildlife Refuge
Thurs., June 7th –   AG PAC meeting at 8:30 am
                               –   ELL Field Trip to  Library
Fri., June 8th      –   Popcorn Friday
Mon. , June 11th –  5th Graders to the Portland Art Museum
Wed., June 13th  – 4th Graders – Sherwood Trail Walk
Thurs., June 14th – End Of Year Assembly
Fri., June 15th      –  Kinder Promotion – 8:00 am
                                –  5th Grade Promotion – 9:15 am
                                –  Last Day of  School Dismissal at 11:15 am
